Great! I can help you with that. To start, I need to know about the children you're asking about. 

**How old are your children?** (Please tell me about each child you want to claim Child Benefit for)

This is important because:
- Children under 16 may automatically qualify
- Children aged 16-19 may qualify if they're in approved education or training
- Children aged 20 or over generally don't qualify

conversation.text:
## ✅ Great News! You ARE Eligible for Child Benefit

**For both Alex (age 8) and Blake (age 14), you meet all the eligibility requirements!**

### Why You're Eligible:
Both children:
- Are under 16 years old
- Live with you in the UK
- Are not working full-time (24+ hours/week)
- Are not receiving benefits in their own right
- Are not in disqualifying apprenticeships
- Are not in local authority care
- Have no local council payments for their accommodation or maintenance

You also meet the residency requirements as you live in the UK, and you are responsible for both children.

### Next Steps to Claim:

1. **Apply for Child Benefit** - You can apply:
   - Online at [www.gov.uk/child-benefit](https://www.gov.uk/child-benefit/how-to-claim)
   - By post using form CH2

2. **Documents you'll need:**
   - Proof of your identity
   - Birth certificates or adoption certificates for Alex and Blake
   - Your National Insurance number

3. **Payment details:**
   - You'll receive payments every 4 weeks for both children
   - (Or weekly if you're a single parent or receiving certain benefits)

4. **Important note about the High Income Child Benefit Charge:**
   - If you or your partner earns over £60,000 per year, you may need to pay back some or all of the Child Benefit through the tax system
   - You can still claim it to get National Insurance credits even if you choose not to receive the payments

Would you like any more information about the claiming process or the High Income Child Benefit Charge?
